gloss: being roused to action; getting motivated; being inspired

definitions.gloss: being roused to action; getting motivated; being inspired
definitions.explanation: having one's spirit stirred up and becoming determined to act

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}に{発奮|はっぷん}した。
examples.english: I was motivated by his words.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}を{機|き}に{発奮|はっぷん}して{頑張|がんば}った。
examples.english: I got motivated after my failure and worked hard.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}の{激励|げきれい}に{発奮|はっぷん}した{選手|せんしゅ}たちは、{後半|こうはん}{逆転|ぎゃくてん}{勝利|しょうり}を{収|おさ}めた。
examples.english: Inspired by the coach's encouragement, the players achieved a comeback victory in the second half.

notes:
{発奮|はっぷん} means to be roused or inspired to action, often triggered by encouragement or adversity.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {発|はつ} (emit, start)
- {奮|ふん} (rouse, stir up)

USAGE:
- {発奮|はっぷん}する (to be roused to action - suru verb)
- 〜に{発奮|はっぷん}する (to be inspired by ~)
- {発奮|はっぷん}させる (to motivate someone)

COMMON TRIGGERS:
- {言葉|ことば}に{発奮|はっぷん}する (inspired by words)
- {悔|くや}しさに{発奮|はっぷん}する (motivated by frustration)
- {激励|げきれい}に{発奮|はっぷん}する (roused by encouragement)

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
- Also written as {発憤|はっぷん}
- {発憤|はっぷん} emphasizes the emotional aspect more

RELATED TERMS:
- {奮起|ふんき} (rousing oneself)
- {奮闘|ふんとう} (hard struggle)
- やる{気|き}になる (to get motivated - casual)
- {鼓舞|こぶ}される (to be encouraged)
